What do you think of Ben?
Do you agree with Jessica's method for getting over someone?
options: Yes! You have to get them out of your head!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'll be back next week. You're okay here by yourself?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Bye, Dad.
Mr. Kale leaves...
Ben has failed.

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Ben's dad shifts uncomfortably in his seat.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: That's... That's personal, son.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know... I'm just not sure what to do about...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: To be straight with you... I'm not sure I'll ever get over your mother...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I guess I hadn't thought about it much, but I'm working more than ever now because...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Because whenever I'm `not` working, I think about her...
nodes.text_bbcode: Because whenever I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] working, I think about her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Dad.
Ben's dad stands up quickly...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Her name was Jenny Weathers... And it wasn't easy...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Wait... Is this about Denni?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We broke up... I feel horrible, and I don't know what to do about it.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: The best remedy for heartache, son, is a hard pill to swallow...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Time and separation.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: You have to endure the heartache for as much time as it takes to heal...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: But the real hard part is the separation...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: If you try to talk to Denni, it'll just reset all the time you spent getting over her.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That sounds awful.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: It is.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Speaking of time, I'm out of it...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `But` there's something that `I` have to tell `you...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]But[/i][/color] there's something that [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] have to tell [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well... I... I kind of thought you `did` break up with me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I... I kind of thought you [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] break up with me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What? Oh Ben, I'm so sorry. I should be locked up for being such a horrible person!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know the feeling...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let me make it up to you somehow...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait. That... That isn't `all` of what I have to tell you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait. That... That isn't [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] of what I have to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: After our fight, I kind of... I kind of... Whew! This is really hard to say!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just say it...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I kissed Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I... Kissed her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I thought you had broken up with me, and I saw you with Colt, and it just... Happened!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, you `saw` me with Colt? Did you see me sticking my tongue down his `throat?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you [color=#3b78e2][i]saw[/i][/color] me with Colt? Did you see me sticking my tongue down his [color=#3b78e2][i]throat?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I didn't stick around for the show!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We weren't fooling around... He was comforting me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is it `comforting` to have his arm around you?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Is it [color=#e23b3b][i]comforting[/i][/color] to have his arm around you?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, it is! That's what `friends` do!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, it is! That's what [color=#3b78e2][i]friends[/i][/color] do!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know what they `don't` do? Kiss each other!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know what they [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] do? Kiss each other!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I just can't believe you did that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah, it's so hard for `you` to believe.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, it's so hard for [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] to believe.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And what's `that` supposed to mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: And what's [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `You` know.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] know.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, kissing Colt when he was with Sam was a mistake... But the difference is `I` wasn't the one in a relationship at the time!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, kissing Colt when he was with Sam was a mistake... But the difference is [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] wasn't the one in a relationship at the time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I told you, I thought you'd broken up with me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did you even hear me that night? I said '`Maybe` we shouldn't be together'... `Maybe!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you even hear me that night? I said '[color=#3b78e2][i]Maybe[/i][/color] we shouldn't be together'... [color=#3b78e2][i]Maybe![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How am I supposed to know that that's girl-code for 'We're still together, I just won't be returning any of your calls!'

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I was mad at you! At least for the stupid Perfume Incident I could...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I could forgive you...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But this... This is unforgivable, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'm saying we weren't broken up before... But we are now...
Denni hangs up the phone before Ben can respond...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She broke up with me... Again... On Christmas...
Ben once again buries his head in his arms...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's no 'but'. I... I love you. I just phrased that weird.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't scare me like that!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I promise not to do it again!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I'll see you when I get back from vacation!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm looking forward to it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Bye, Ben!
Denni hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can't believe I got away with that... I am an `incredible` liar!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe I got away with that... I am an [color=#e23b3b][i]incredible[/i][/color] liar!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can get away with `anything!
That night, Ben's sitting in a hot tub at a college party!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: You're so young-looking for a college student!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I have a disease that always makes me look a little bit younger than I actually am.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's called `Awesome-itis!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's called [color=#e23b3b][i]Awesome-itis![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: That sounds... Awesome!
A week later, when class resumes...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: You won't be turning in your homework because...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: As you can see, the Supreme Court has ruled in my favor in the case of `Kale vs. The Board of Education.`
nodes.text_bbcode: As you can see, the Supreme Court has ruled in my favor in the case of [color=#e23b3b][i]Kale vs. The Board of Education.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: This is highly suspect, Ben... But for some reason, I trust you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I knew you would...
The next weekend, Ben strolls into a bank and approaches the bank manager.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hello! I would like to withdraw all the money from my account.

nodes.speaker: Manager
nodes.text: I see... And who are you, sir?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am deeply offended that you do not recognize me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm Tom Prince!

nodes.speaker: Manager
nodes.text: Oh... I'm... I'm confused. I thought Tom Prince looked... Blonder.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're telling me you `don't` know how I, `the` Tom Prince, looks? Fetch me your manager!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're telling me you [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] know how I, [color=#e23b3b][i]the[/i][/color] Tom Prince, looks? Fetch me your manager!

nodes.speaker: Manager
nodes.text: But I am the manager!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If you were the manager, I'd never keep my fortune in such an institution of incompetence!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Surely someone manages `you...` You can't even wear a suit right!
nodes.text_bbcode: Surely someone manages [color=#e23b3b][i]you...[/i][/color] You can't even wear a suit right!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're a short in a regular, you've buttoned your bottom button, and your Windsor is an eyesore!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now get me your superior!

nodes.speaker: Manager
nodes.text: That won't be necessary... I'll just bring up your file and verify the photo ID...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...My what?
A year later, Ben slumps in a cell in a Maximum Security prison...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If only I hadn't lied to my girlfriend!
A powerful lesson for boyfriends everywhere... Lie to your girlfriend, go to jail!
That might not be quite how it works all the time, but I think Ben's learned his lesson...
Try again and see what happens when Ben confesses his kiss with Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look, Ben, just... Let me talk, okay? I'm going to explode if I can't vent everything I've been thinking...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I don't think either of us want you to explode...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Go ahead. I'm listening...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've... I've been agonizing so much about the fight we had that night...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: At first, I was really angry with you. I couldn't believe how much you were trivializing the... The Perfume Incident.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But after I calmed down, I realized that I don't care about who was right and who was wrong...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I love you, Ben, and I hate to even think about how it would feel `if we ever broke up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I love you, Ben, and I hate to even think about how it would feel [color=#3b78e2][i]if we ever broke up.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `If` we ever broke up?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]If[/i][/color] we ever broke up?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni thinks we're still together!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, Denni... I love you, too. I really do...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why do I feel like there's a 'but' coming here?
Ben steps into the circle!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! `Another` high schooler?! Are you going to defend your girlfriend now?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! [color=#3b78e2][i]Another[/i][/color] high schooler?! Are you going to defend your girlfriend now?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's not my girlfriend, but she is my friend!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Ha! Right... You just think she's hot, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not it at all!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just broke up with my girlfriend, and Jessica's been kind-hearted enough to try and help me get over it!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You might be jealous, but she `is` a good person.
nodes.text_bbcode: You might be jealous, but she [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] a good person.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe you should think first before leveling accusations at someone...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, well, whatever...
Tina turns away...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben... That was really kind of you.
Ben hesitates!
Amanda steps into the circle!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, she's my friend!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! `Another` high schooler?! Are you here to steal all the guys away too?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh my gosh! [color=#3b78e2][i]Another[/i][/color] high schooler?! Are you here to steal all the guys away too?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! Stealing is wrong!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I really like your hair!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Uh... Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And you're pretty! We should go dance!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Um... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I made a friend! Come on, Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I think I'll pass...
Ben walks up to Jessica...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm just glad Amanda was there to diffuse things...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: To be honest, I kind of thought you might be the one to step in.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry... I froze up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks for listening...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Man... You're kind of depressing, kid.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Yeah. Ever since you got here, I've been feeling down.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No offense, but you're too depressing... Even for `me!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No offense, but you're too depressing... Even for [color=#3b78e2][i]me![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I failed Jessica's challenge... I feel miserable.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: All I can think about is Denni, and now I have to return to Jessica with my tail between my legs...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But it wasn't romantic or anything. It was for a Secret Santa program at school.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That's really nice.
Dinah winks at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And I'm sure there wasn't anything romantic about it at all!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh... Is she your girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... She was my girlfriend. We broke up last week.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Aww, I'm so sorry to hear that!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: You should try writing out your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I would, but that's not going to bring her back.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You made perfume for a girl, and you can't remember her name?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, I made perfume for two girls...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: One of them is now my ex-girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Sorry to hear that...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: You should try writing out your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I would, but that's not going to bring her back.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Uh... Where'd you get those weird pants?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This store called `Jeaneology...`
nodes.text_bbcode: This store called [color=#e23b3b][i]Jeaneology...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Or at least I knew someone.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean, I still know her...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I mean... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... You have such a palpable sadness.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: His name's Spencer. He's a linebacker!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's a position, right?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Heh. That is. I was a quarterback.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nice. I `know` that's definitely a position.
nodes.text_bbcode: Nice. I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] that's definitely a position.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: A what?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I forgot... Sorry... I've been dealing with something personal...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Sure. Crap happens...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: You go to Centerscore High, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: I used to play football there... Before I got into writing poetry. Writing really saved me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Cool! You know, I'm close with someone who's a...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: What? No... Who is sappy enough to count kisses?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No one... I just heard that, uh, smart people did that in... Spain.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: We were talking about poetry.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess Denni and I are the only ones sappy enough to count kisses...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah! How'd you guess?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You guys talk like poets...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hee. You're pretty smart!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Counting what?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's okay, kid. You don't have to be nervous around us.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm not nervous!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm just feeling off...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: We were talking about syllables for a haiku Adam and I were co-writing...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Well, have fun, man!
Ben steps into the house...
A camera-phone flashes in his eyes as the girls walk up to him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shoot! I thought I might get a smile if I took a super candid shot of you!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Isn't this an awesome party?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... What are we doing here?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Having fun... Duh!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I mean, what does this party have to do with... My problem?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You've gotten rid of all things Denni...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now you just have to prove that she's out of your mind...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?
Jessica gestures to the party...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Get out there.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Socialize. Mingle. Your challenge is to talk to other people `without` mentioning her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Socialize. Mingle. Your challenge is to talk to other people [color=#3b78e2][i]without[/i][/color] mentioning her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You up for it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I think so...
Jessica points to a group of college students on a nearby couch...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There's your target... Good luck.
Ben takes a deep breath, walks over to the couch, and squeezes in...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: So then what happened?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Well, I wanted to just have five... For rhythm, you know...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But we couldn't help ourselves and went all the way to ten!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you guys talking about counting...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just got out of a relationship...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Sorry to hear that, man.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica's been nice to me... She's really been helping me through my problems lately.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Yeah, everybody at MAN really loves her. She's so fun!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, she's been `really` nice to me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, she's been [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] nice to me.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Not your type?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: So then you're `not` into fun, hot chicks?
nodes.text_bbcode: So then you're [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] into fun, hot chicks?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, I'm more into the cute and sarcastic type...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Sure you are...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I am!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now come on. It's time to do something `a lot` more fun...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now come on. It's time to do something [color=#3b78e2][i]a lot[/i][/color] more fun...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's more fun than this?!
That night, Ben and the girls show up on the doorstep of a MAN frat party.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Jessica! Nicole! Come on in!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is it cool if my other friends come in too?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Toga! Toga!
The girls go in. Ben follows, but Chuck stops him.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Ben, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's me.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: You're the dude who's been throwing all those killer parties for Centerscore High, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right again.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Awesome, man!
Chuck leans down to Ben...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey, on the down low, bro...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: I've heard Jessica talking about you... I think she might be into you, you know?

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: You into her?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica?! No... She's...
Ben holds back his tears as he tosses the pumpkin into the fire.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Goodbye, Denni.
Jessica puts her arm around him.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That was the hardest thing I ever had to do...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I can't do it!
Ben hugs the pumpkin to his chest. Jessica sighs.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You were so close...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're sure you're going to keep it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sure. But I'm not going to obsess over it... I promise.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You shouldn't be making promises you can't keep.
Jessica walks back into the house...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All that's left is the stuff in your jacket pockets.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sheesh. Nothing gets by you...
Ben reaches into his pockets and takes out the gifts Denni got him for Secret Santa...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This beaker... Is from when we first met...
Ben tosses it into the fire.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: These are spoons that she got as replacements for two that I gave to the twins.
Ben tosses them into the fire.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This lugnut is from the van where we pretended to kiss...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: In the same parking lot where minutes later we had our first real kiss...
Ben hesitates a few seconds before tossing it into the fire.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is that it?
Ben glances guiltily at a plastic pumpkin on the back porch... Jessica raises an eyebrow.
Ben gets the pumpkin and returns.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And this... This plastic pumpkin symbolizes when we finally became a couple... On Halloween night...
Ben stares at the pumpkin...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We made a pumpkin, and then we found a diamond bracelet inside of it... The one I gave to her.
Ben holds the pumpkin out toward the fire...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, Ben... This is the last thing you'll have to destroy, I promise.

nodes.prompt: What should you do with the pumpkin?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What should you do with the pumpkin?

nodes.text: Ben sets the pile on fire!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! I'll go get the s'mores!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good... That wasn't easy. I'm really proud of you, Ben.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I feel so... Empty.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know it's hard to believe, but that's right where you want to be.
Jessica takes Ben's hand and gives it a squeeze.
Ben hesitates, the flame inches away from the pile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's too hard, isn't it? You're still attached to her even though she dumped you on Christmas, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Do you want help?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...
Jessica stands close to Ben and holds his hand, the one with the lighter in it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ready?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-huh.
Gently, she and Ben ease the flame into the pile and set it alight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There... It's done.
After Ben deletes all the pictures of him and Denni...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh... And to get started on a new collection of pictures... Smile!
Jessica snaps another picture.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well... We'll get a good one by the end of the day, I'm sure!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now gather up all the things in your room that remind you of her...
The girls start grabbing up all the Ben-Denni stuff...
Ticket stubs, pictures, stuffed animals, and boxes of memorable knick-knacks.
Ben takes the gifts Denni got him for Secret Santa and puts them in his jacket pockets.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are we going to do with all this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll see... Let's take it all outside.
Ben and the girls step into the backyard with all of the things that remind Ben of Denni.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Here... This trash-can will do the trick!
Jessica, Nicole, and Amanda stuff everything into the trash-can.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's it?
Jessica hands Ben a lighter.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Almost. Now you just have to burn it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Burn it? I don't know if I can do that.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Come on, Ben. It'll be good for you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Trust me. It `has` to be done.
nodes.text_bbcode: Trust me. It [color=#3b78e2][i]has[/i][/color] to be done.

nodes.text: Ben sparks the lighter and holds it over the pile...
Ben types in his new password...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, that looked a lot like your `old` password.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, that looked a lot like your [color=#3b78e2][i]old[/i][/color] password.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, this one is I Love `Lenni!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, this one is I Love [color=#e23b3b][i]Lenni![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I `love` my Uncle Lenny too!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] my Uncle Lenny too!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come `on,` Ben! If you're going to get over her, you've got to actually try!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come [color=#3b78e2][i]on,[/i][/color] Ben! If you're going to get over her, you've got to actually try!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just a password...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, it starts there, then it's just a picture you keep, just a ticket from a movie you guys saw together...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Soon, it's `just` a phone call. `Just` a visit! And before you know it, you're a creepy ex-boyfriend!
nodes.text_bbcode: Soon, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] a phone call. [color=#3b78e2][i]Just[/i][/color] a visit! And before you know it, you're a creepy ex-boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I hate creepy ex-boyfriends...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. I'll change it later, okay? Let's just delete some pictures...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine.
Ben types in his new password...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I changed it to `JessicaIsMyFriend.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I changed it to [color=#e23b3b][i]JessicaIsMyFriend.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aww, that is `so` sweet!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aww, that is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sweet!

nodes.text: Jessica gives Ben a kiss on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Now you'll think of me whenever you do your smart-guy computer stuff!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And whenever you type this in, you'll remember how strong you were.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah... It's not easy to erase someone from your memory...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Jessica is `my` friend too!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jessica is [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] friend too!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Let's deal with these pictures now!
Ben types in his new password...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I changed it to something innocuous...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Good! No one will be able to spell that!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I meant...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait... What did you change it to?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's just a random phrase... `ParkingLot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's just a random phrase... [color=#e23b3b][i]ParkingLot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That `isn't` random, Ben. You guys had your first kiss in a parking lot!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] random, Ben. You guys had your first kiss in a parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I... I guess we did. You don't think I picked that phrase subconsciously, do you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is exactly why we're here, Ben. You've got `her` stuck in your mind in ways `you` don't even see.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is exactly why we're here, Ben. You've got [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] stuck in your mind in ways [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] don't even see.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow... Thanks, Jessica... I don't think I realized just how much I'd made her a part of my life...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess I'll change my password again...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's okay, you can do it later. But we'll get rid of those pictures now.
Ben takes out his wallet to pay, but as he opens it, a wad of pictures falls out onto the floor!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What are these?!
Jessica picks up the pictures...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Pictures of you and `her?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Pictures of you and [color=#3b78e2][i]her?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wait... Are you telling me you haven't gotten rid of all the junk from your relationship?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Is that something I'm supposed to do?
Jessica dumps the pictures in a trash-can.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, those are...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh! My! Gosh! Ben! Buy your pants, then take us to your house!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We need to clean out all the junk that reminds you of `her!`
nodes.text_bbcode: We need to clean out all the junk that reminds you of [color=#3b78e2][i]her![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Field trip! Whoop!
Twenty minutes later, Ben and the girls walk into Ben's room...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do we have to toss out?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Everything` that reminds you of her!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Everything[/i][/color] that reminds you of her!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Everything?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah! Seeing something that reminds you of her is `worse` than actually talking to her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Yeah! Seeing something that reminds you of her is [color=#3b78e2][i]worse[/i][/color] than actually talking to her!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Every time you see it, you end up thinking she's, like, perfect or something!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aww... Look at Ben's screensaver!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's a bunch of pictures of him, and the girl whose name we're not allowed to say...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You know, Denni!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We'll start with all these pictures on your computer!
Jessica sits Ben down in front of his computer, and he types in his password.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Wait... Is your password something lame like 'I love Denni'?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Incidentally, that password's not `that` lame, is it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Incidentally, that password's not [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] lame, is it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It is, Ben. It's super lame.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You've got to change it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine...
Ben navigates to the Change Password screen. A prompt for his new password appears...
Ben changes in a dressing room. A few minutes later, he steps out...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whoa! Those are hot, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Now `I` want jeans!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want jeans!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I feel good.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't take this the wrong way, but you look, like, super hot!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm `so` glad you listened to me!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] glad you listened to me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I figured my way of doing things hasn't been helping me much...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And if you're going to be my guide, I should probably listen to you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Besides, you're my friend.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Awww, Ben. That makes me way happy!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This is a really good step in getting over... You know...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She Who Must Not Be Named?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Haha!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is it me?
Ben changes in a dressing room. A few minutes later, he steps out...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They're ugly... But they remind me of Denni... She would have loved these jeans...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I love Denni! How am I ever going to be without her?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ugh. This is exactly why I was advising you against them!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Just buy the other ones like I said in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I'm buying my Denni jeans! If I can't have her, at least I can have these!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Fine! But you're acting pathetic!
Twenty minutes later...
Ben enters the mall and finds Jessica standing near the entrance, flanked by Nicole and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Hey, girls.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hi, Ben! Ready to `shop till you drop?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hi, Ben! Ready to [color=#e23b3b][i]shop till you drop?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: I did that once! But it was okay 'cause I landed on my head!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...
Hey, Blue Eyes! Say cheese!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?
Jessica takes a picture of Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Aww, you weren't smiling... We'll get a better pic later! But now, it's shopping time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! That's my favorite time!
Ben follows the girls into a clothing store called `Jeaneology.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben follows the girls into a clothing store called [b]Jeaneology.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't understand... How does shopping help me get over Denni?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shh! As long as you're under my guidance, we don't mention her name, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, you've already taken the first step! You got out of your house!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Being cooped up like that doesn't help!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I get out plenty...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Please. When was the last time you were in a naturally-lit place like the mall?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I thought so! You're exhibiting all the classic depressed-guy symptoms, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The best way to feel good about yourself is to get out of those scratchy nerd-pants and step into some comfortable jeans.
Jessica hands Ben a nice pair of jeans.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: These `do` feel nice...
nodes.text_bbcode: These [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] feel nice...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or you could wear tighter ones!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah... I guess you `could.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... I guess you [color=#3b78e2][i]could.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `One` leg at a time. Trust me.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]One[/i][/color] leg at a time. Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think I'll try on...

nodes.text: Excuse me...
Ben gets up... He wanders through the party...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where is she?
He turns a corner and finds Jessica and Tina glaring at each other, a crowd of people surrounding them!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: It just seems like you spend an awful lot of time at parties `you're` not invited to!
nodes.text_bbcode: It just seems like you spend an awful lot of time at parties [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] not invited to!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatev! People like when I come to their parties because I make them fun!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, `guys` think you're fun because all you do is flirt with them all night!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, [color=#3b78e2][i]guys[/i][/color] think you're fun because all you do is flirt with them all night!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Gasp!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's not true... I'm not like that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Jessica's in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'd really like to just go home now...
After Jessica drops Nicole and Amanda off, she drives to her house...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are we doing `here?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are we doing [color=#e23b3b][i]here?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I figured both of us could probably use some company...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You could come in and meet my family!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Unless you `want` me to take you back to that mansion of yours so you can be alone again!
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless you [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] me to take you back to that mansion of yours so you can be alone again!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni thinks we're still together!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, Denni... I love you, too. I really do...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why do I feel like there's a 'but' coming here?
Ben's dad walks in with a bowl of instant oatmeal...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Christmas is a time for comfort and joy. I don't remember any carols about frowns and mopeyness.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: What's going on? Did you get your first B+?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's nothing.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Ah... Then I will cheer up this awful 'nothing' with a gift!
He hands Ben a small Christmas present.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's kind of little, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Don't be fooled by its size...
Ben unwraps the gift.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's a... A tiny microscope.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Now, I know you already have a dozen microscopes, but this one's special because it's a `pocket` microscope!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, I know you already have a dozen microscopes, but this one's special because it's a [color=#e23b3b][i]pocket[/i][/color] microscope!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: This lets you study the infinitesimal no matter where you are!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's been so distracted... With the divorce and with work... He doesn't know that I'm not the same nerdy kid anymore...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Feel better?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... A little, yeah. Thanks, Dad...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Can I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Sure. But make it quick, I have to get to the airport soon...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The airport?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: My lab is working with an East Coast pharmaceutical company on a line of palatable cold medicine for the new year.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'm responsible for flavoring something called Auld Lang Sinus Relief...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're working? On Christmas?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'm afraid flavors don't take holidays.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Unless you want to live in a world without Lemon Potato Clam Syrup...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Who wouldn't?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: What did you want to ask?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... Um... I was wondering...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How did you get over...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... I think I'll pass on being alone.
Jessica takes a quick picture of him with her phone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I knew I'd get one of you smiling!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on! I'll introduce you to my family!
Inside, Jessica checks every room of the house...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Mom? Dad?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: They're not here...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well... I guess I can show you my room, at least...
They walk into Jessica's room...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Looks like they left a note for me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's it say?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It says they've gone to Napa for the weekend...
Jessica sits down on the bed...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your room looks nice.
Ben hears the low sound of her crying softly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Sniffle!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sniffle![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I meant, it looks... Ugly?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, it has nothing to do with you... It's just my parents are never here...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's like... It's like they don't care...
Ben reaches out and wipes a tear from Jessica's cheek.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know what that's like.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I know you do...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Want to see something cool?
He takes out his pocket microscope...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm not going to play any nerd games if that's what you're asking.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Relax. It's a microscope... Take a look.
Ben places the microscope over the tear on his finger. Jessica leans over and looks through.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's... It's... Beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Also, your finger is `really` ugly. I'd think about moisturizer.
nodes.text_bbcode: Also, your finger is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] ugly. I'd think about moisturizer.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh.
Their eyes meet for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't know if I said it before, but I'm really proud of you, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You made some really good changes today.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't really know how to thank you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Don't thank me yet. This is just the beginning...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: When I, um, kissed you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And you... Kissed me back...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you, you know, like it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I did...
Ben steps closer to Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Are you...?
He leans down and kisses Jessica, pulling her closer to him!
After a moment, Jessica kisses Ben back!
Whoa! Ben and Jessica?! It looks like Ben has gotten over Denni...
And even though he might be rushing into things with Jessica...
`You` played a great game! You helped him remove all traces of Denni from his life!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]You[/b] played a great game! You helped him remove all traces of Denni from his life!

nodes.text: And for now, that's for the best!
